user.title: Connect Yuvomi
user.description: Create an API token in Yuvomi Settings → API Tokens with tasks:write scope. Set the timezone to match the Yuvomi household. The interface enhancement is experimental.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read Yuvomi tasks or metadata. Check URL, token permissions and server availability.
error.invalid_config: Check the URL, token and timezone (for example Europe/London).

abort.already_configured: This Yuvomi server is already configured.

init.title: Yuvomi options
init.description: After changing the interface option, refresh the HA browser tab.

error.invalid_config: Enter a valid timezone, for example Europe/London.
